name: Dakkan Kikou Luvnatier
original_name: 奪還機構 ラヴネイティア
source:
Main character is a master of the coffee shop. But his true occupation is the leader of combat maid unit using nano-technology to transform and defeat evil. Two waitresses and childhood friend make the rest of the team.
